items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Chauncey Morehouse) is not present in the transcript; the text describes the interviewer's interaction with Bill Donahoe. The interviewee is merely the subject of the interview, and no personal connection between Chauncey Morehouse and Bill Donahoe is stated.

ctx.x: Did you go into the Bix Beiderbecke festivals at Davenport?
No, we went up to Long Valley. This Bill Donahoe...
Did you really? So did I.
